descripcion: Preguntas con su consulta 'de oro' escrita a mano. El evaluador (backend/scripts/bi_evaluar_oro.py) compara el RESULTADO que da el asistente con el de la consulta de oro, no el texto del SQL. Division: 'entrenamiento' (sus errores se pueden convertir en ejemplos del banco) y 'prueba' (nunca se usan para entrenar).

preguntas.oro: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material WHERE deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM brand WHERE deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM location WHERE deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_supplier WHERE deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proyect WHERE deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM department WHERE deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT product_status, COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY product_status
SELECT task_status, COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY task_status
SELECT u.unit_name, COUNT(*) FROM material m JOIN unit u ON u.id_unit = m.id_unit WHERE m.deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY u.unit_name
SELECT b.brand_description, COUNT(*) FROM product p JOIN brand b ON b.id_brand = p.id_marca WHERE p.deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY b.brand_description
SELECT id_incident FROM incident WHERE deletion_date IS NULL ORDER BY incident_date DESC, id_incident DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE incident_status = 'abierta' AND deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE incident_status = 'cerrada' AND deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT u.full_name, COUNT(*) FROM incident i JOIN "user" u ON u.id_user = i.id_user WHERE i.deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY u.full_name
SELECT date_trunc('month', incident_date)::date, COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND incident_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proyect WHERE proyect_status = 'authorized' AND deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proyect WHERE proyect_status = 'in_progress' AND deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE task_status = 'pendiente' AND deletion_date IS NULL
